entities.summary: Johannes Lingelbach was a Dutch Golden Age painter, associated with the second generation of Bambocciate, a group of genre painters working in Rome from 1625–1700. Johannes Lingelbach was a painters & sculptors from Frankfurt (1622-10-10, Frankfurt–1674). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
